WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.units), 0) AS total_units
    FROM generate_series(
        date_trunc('month', (SELECT MIN(day) FROM sales_daily)),
        date_trunc('month', (SELECT MAX(day) FROM sales_daily)),
        INTERVAL '1 month'
    ) AS months(month)
    LEFT JOIN sales_daily s
        ON date_trunc('month', s.day) = months.month
    GROUP BY month
),
comparison AS (
    SELECT
        total_units,
        LAG(total_units) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_total_units
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM comparison
WHERE previous_total_units IS NOT NULL
  AND total_units > previous_total_units

JOIN sales_daily s ON p.sku = s.sku
WHERE p.unit_cost < 10

SELECT DISTINCT products.sku
FROM products
JOIN sales_daily ON products.sku = sales_daily.sku
WHERE products.unit_cost < 10

SELECT DISTINCT s.supplier_id, s.name
FROM suppliers s
JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
WHERE p.sku IN (
    SELECT sd.sku
    FROM sales_daily sd
    GROUP BY sd.sku
    HAVING SUM(sd.units) > 1000
)

SELECT DISTINCT s.supplier_id, s.name
FROM suppliers s
JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
JOIN sales_daily sd ON p.sku = sd.sku
GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.name, p.sku
HAVING SUM(sd.units) > 1000

SELECT w.name
FROM warehouses w
JOIN stock s ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.name
ORDER BY SUM(s.on_hand) DESC, w.name ASC
LIMIT 1
